card.name: Words just before 'resistance' to drugs
card.fires_on: Linking words such as 'of' right after 'development' or 'emergence', and verbs like 'becoming' or 'prevent', where the next word is likely 'resistance' or 'resistant'. Also seen inside 'Lamivudine' before '-Resistant'.

modes.label: 'of' after development/emergence
modes.description: The word 'of' following 'development' or 'emergence', with 'resistance' expected next in drug-interaction warnings.
modes.example: etravirine tablets with atazanavir/cobicistat is not recommended because it may result in loss of therapeutic effect and development<< of>> resistance to atazanavir.

modes.label: Verbs leading to resistant
modes.description: A verb such as 'becoming' or 'prevent' that leads into 'resistant' or 'resistance' in antibiotic or pesticide text.
modes.example: With so many bacteria<< becoming>> antibiotic resistant it is necessary to use not
